interpretation: V2.8.8 selected no candidate under the frozen cross-fold development eligibility rule.
C2 dual-compression plus momentum is directionally negative on D+10 in all three consumed folds and is retired.
C3 dual-compression plus near-high structure is not cross-fold robust and is retired.

C1 dual-compression plus trend structure is positive in folds 0 and 2 but negative in fold1 and fails additional cross-fold stability conditions; it is not promotable and must not be rescued by post-result weight, threshold or trend-definition tuning.
V2.8.8 does not invalidate the independently replicated V2.8.6 continuous dual-compression mechanism. It rejects the three frozen additive static-level translations tested here.

Together with V2.8.7, the evidence does not justify treating a high same-day level of the compression score, alone or in the three tested equal-weight structural combinations, as a validated Setup event.

setup_interface_boundary.finding: The downstream admission envelope requires a PASS strategy receipt for the same security/date with outcome_data_consumed=false, but it treats strategy semantics as opaque and does not require a Q5 or other fixed cross-sectional percentile definition.
setup_interface_boundary.consequence: A static top-quintile level rule is an implementation assumption, not a system hard constraint.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Produce one prospective, non-leaking and economically meaningful entry Setup that can later issue a strategy PASS receipt and survive untouched validation.
hard_constraints: Keep V2.8.6 continuous dual-compression replication intact as historical evidence.
Honor V2.8.7 and V2.8.8 terminal rejections without reevaluation or rescue.
Keep fold3 and fold4 untouched until one materially new Setup hypothesis, implementation and validation gate are frozen.
A future Setup receipt must be signal-date causal and must not consume outcome data.
U/E eligibility remains independent from T-layer strategy evidence.
No Setup, First60, Episode or live authorization exists yet.
soft_assumptions_removed: A Setup must be defined by the same-day level of a continuous cross-sectional score.
A Setup must use Q5 >80% versus Q1 <=20% as its action interface.
Adding another static structural score to dual compression is necessary to create entry timing.

priority_actions.Delete: Retire V2.8.7 pure-compression Q5 and all three V2.8.8 additive static-level candidates as Setup candidates.
priority_actions.Avoid: Do not spend more development budget on percentile grids, equal-weight variants, coefficient fitting or nearby static threshold rescue on folds 0-2.
priority_actions.Absorb: Retain dual compression only as a replicated continuous T-layer state/ranking primitive; reuse existing source snapshots, identity folds and scale-invariant feature engine.
priority_actions.Substitute: Move the next Setup research question from static level classification to a temporal event/transition hypothesis: whether a causal change in compression state can define entry timing better than being highly compressed on every qualifying date.
priority_actions.Precompute_Reuse: Derive any D-only transition features from already frozen folds 0-2 and existing daily feature histories; do not re-fetch folds 0-2 solely for this purpose.
priority_actions.Optimize: Only after one transition/event hypothesis is frozen; no local optimization of the rejected static-level candidates.

why_transition_is_the_next_question_not_: The existing V2.8.7/V2.8.8 evaluators score static same-day levels repeatedly across signal dates; they do not encode a transition or first-occurrence event.
A replicated continuous cross-sectional relation can exist without implying that every day in a high-score state is a distinct entry event.

V2.8.8 therefore does not claim that a transition Setup works. It only establishes that transition/event semantics are a materially different, still-unanswered hypothesis that avoids further static-threshold rescue.

fold_disposition.fold1: consumed independent mechanism replication and V2.8.8 development
fold_disposition.fold3: sealed untouched validation for one future pre-frozen materially new Setup hypothesis
fold_disposition.fold4: sealed untouched final cross-sectional holdout after fold3 success

next_stage_constraints: V2.8.9 must define a materially new temporal/event hypothesis rather than another static score-level threshold.
Hypothesis generation and diagnostics may use only already-consumed folds 0-2.
Any transition feature must use D and earlier observations only; no future-state confirmation is permitted in signal construction.
Episode/de-duplication semantics, if used, must be frozen before inspecting fold3.
Freeze exactly one candidate event definition and one fold3 PASS/FAIL contract before any fold3 price/outcome access.
Fold3 remains validation-only; a failure cannot be tuned on fold3.
Fold4 remains sealed unless the pre-frozen fold3 gate passes.
